gloss: living in (at one's workplace); live-in job

definitions.gloss: living in at one's place of work; a live-in job
definitions.explanation: Working at a place while also living there, with room and often board provided: live-in staff at an inn, a farm or a household.

examples.japanese: {住|す}み{込|こ}み⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{住|す}み{込|こ}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つけた→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I found a live-in job at a Japanese inn.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧、⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{牧場|ぼくじょう}→牧場：06103_bokujou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{住|す}み{込|こ}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦アルバイト→アルバイト：01528_arubaito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Over the summer vacation I did a live-in part-time job on a ranch in Hokkaido.

notes:
From the verb {住|す}み{込|こ}む (to live in at one's workplace). Job listings use it as a selling point: {住|す}み{込|こ}み{可|か} (live-in available), ⟦{寮|りょう}→寮：03800_ryou⟧・{食事付|しょくじつ}き.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {住|す}み{込|こ}み⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: to work as a live-in employee
- {住|す}み{込|こ}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧: a live-in job
- {住|す}み{込|こ}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{弟子|でし}→弟子：03986_deshi⟧: a live-in apprentice

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{通|かよ}い→通う：01217_kayou⟧: commuting to work from one's own home (the opposite arrangement)
